He was a Buddhist monk known for being happy-go-lucky, good-natured, and giving candy to children. Hotei was later thought to be a manifestation of Metteya, the future world Buddha. This is why people confuse Hotei for the historical Gautama Buddha (or just "The Buddha"). The size of his belly is a symbolic representation of his wisdom and kindheartedness and doesn't imply that he was actually fat.

Top 5 Ways Blade And Soul Can Improve

The tried-and-true MMO leveling scheme exists because it works fairly well, isn't overly difficult to implement, and the alternatives can make the game a pain to balance or otherwise detract from development.

That aside, I'm disappointed to see the story criticized in Blade and Soul. While certain localisation issues leave the plot a bit less coherent than the original intention, why does the entire story have to be scrapped just so you can have a choose-your-own-adventure game?

It's one of those things that people always suggest freely without understanding how much it can complicate design. Branching storylines are something popularized by classical RPG's, largely single player experiences. In these cases, you simply need to worry about the play experience from beginning to end. The problem with taking a branching world story into an MMORPG mainly lies in how you tie that branching world story into a massively multiplayer community. You're either left with decisions that are only superficially different, which is wholly dissatisfying, or decisions that fracture the community into distinct pockets that can't functionally interact due to dramatic differences in world-states. You would basically have to take narrative pains to enable players to interact across fissures in their divergent timelines in order to make it work at all, and as cool as that sounds it hardly lends itself well to more than a few games using it as a central game mechanic.

I'm sorry, but "I wish that I had more control over the story" is the criticism equivalent of a gish gallop. Not every game has to be about you being a special snowflake.
